title: Roadmap Goals
html:
This guide covers everything required to pass GenAI interviews, structured in three progressive tiers. Master core vocabulary, system architectures, and production scaling scenarios.

Level 1 — Easy

Goal: "I know what every buzzword means."
Covers AI/ML/DL basics, basic NLP, tokenization, parameters, context, and prompts. Answers 50-60% of basic questions under a 1-minute read strategy.

Level 2 — Medium

Goal: "I know how modern GenAI works."
Dives into Transformer internals (self-attention), GPT (decoder-only) vs BERT (encoder-only), embeddings, RAG pipeline, prompt engineering patterns, and fine-tuning techniques (LoRA).

Level 3 — Hard

Goal: "I can design GenAI systems."
Covers LLM APIs vs local, agents/multi-agent orchestration, vector search & indexing, diffusion/GAN architectures, latency/cost optimizations, and production guardrails.

Getting Started

Use the sidebar to jump directly to any topic. Use the Search Box at the top of the sidebar to immediately locate terminology definitions or find solutions to specific interview questions.
